name: warm-row-selection-and-completeness
body: warm_prepared selects the first committed scan row in redb iteration order whose content_key and cache_key match the tree; rows agreeing on both describe the same tree so any is equivalent, but if two matching rows ever carry divergent refs the first silently wins, so add a deterministic tie-break only if divergent same-key rows become possible. Its completeness check skips the tool-owned top-level apg/ layout (which never carries a fact unit), but still requires a unit for every other manifest entry, so a scan whose user blacklist or structural-scope exclude drops tracked files (no unit, no node) never warms; skip those entries with the same predicate when excluded-path scans need warm.
